_note: Hand-written. Only names confirmed in docs/campus/boards and the 2024 campus map, each with its basis. Keys are ids in campus.json (OSM ids, or new_tower / south_block / main_rest from tools/campus-heights.py). Anything not listed shows as 'Campus building'.

main_rest.name: Main hospital
main_rest.what: Priority 1A. The 2024 campus map lists St. John, Strawbridge, Main and Conklin, north to south. Where each one starts isn't confirmed yet, so St. John isn't marked.
main_rest.basis: Connected complex between Prospect Ave and 2nd St on the 2024 campus map.

south_block.name: South tower of the main hospital
south_block.what: Priority 1B. Likely Schlesinger Pavilion, the "Pavilion" (owner: about 9 stories). Waiting on the nurse to confirm.
south_block.basis: The 2024 map puts Schlesinger Pavilion at this end. Lidar shows the complex's only roof over 40 m here, in both the 2014 and the 2023 to 2025 scans.

new_tower.name: Helena Theurer Pavilion
new_tower.what: Priority 1C. Surgical and intensive care tower, opened 2023.
new_tower.basis: Position from the 2024 map (east side, along 2nd St). Lidar shows it went up between the 2014 and the 2023 to 2025 scans, about 52 m tall, consistent with HMH's "nine-story" description (tall surgical floors).
